Crime & Law · India

Multiple Indian Recruitment Exam Results Announced

The Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board has released the results for Constable recruitment, shortlisting 76,184 candidates for document verification and physical standard tests. Separately, the UPSSSC Excise Constable recruitment drive has shortlisted 32,891 candidates for mains examination. In Andhra Pradesh, the NEET UG 2026 rank-wise list was released by NTRUHS, making 33,220 candidates eligible. Additionally, UP DElEd BTC results for the 2nd and 4th semesters were announced, with a significant number of students failing.
